statements.approval: Label warnings required by the European Medicines Agency (2019), Health Canada (2021), Australia's TGA (2024); the UK MHRA tracks PSSD with a MedDRA code. The US FDA has done none of this (2018 citizen petition unanswered; Public Citizen lawsuit, May 2024).
